objective.stated: narrow P90 - P50 of decision latency from 100 ns to <= 70 ns, target P90 <= 260 ns
objective.operative_target_after_orchestrator_revi: P90 down, measured in cycles under the code-only I-cache/BTB eviction condition; P50 budget <= +54 TSC ticks; instruction count uncapped; pair_diff 0/500 on three maps
objective.verdict: NEGATIVE on P90. No construct reached the -2 quantum (-54 tick) P90 bar on any map, and none improved P90 on all three. A real and reproducible narrowing of P90-P50 was found, but it is bought entirely by raising P50, which does not lower P90 and therefore does not serve a prize judged on tail latency.

conditions.build_machine: quant-compiler (AMD EPYC 9T25, 64 logical CPUs, KVM guest), GCC 14.3.1
conditions.machine_load_during_measurement: 116-119 users, load average 63 at Step 1, 88-90 at the final A/B

eviction_condition.name: code-only I-cache/BTB eviction
eviction_condition.description: 600 64-byte-aligned functions, each containing one data-dependent conditional branch, walked in full before every timed call
eviction_condition.record_correction: the CHANGELOG's '68 KB I-cache/BTB eviction' is the SIZE OF THE bench_thrash BINARY (size -A Total = 69694 B), not the victim footprint; nm places thrashOne<0>..<599> 38400 B apart

rejected_condition.name: cold2 (16 MiB data write-through plus the code victim set)
rejected_condition.why_rejected: destroys the signal: path-selection variance share eta2 collapses from 0.62-0.68 to 0.10-0.21, within-path widths balloon from 27-54 to 216-243 ticks, and no-fallback rounds then supply 17-46% of the slowest decile

instrument.protocol: per-round minimum over 31 reps; reps interleaved across all .so inside one process; N independent runs; per-round median across runs where a consensus level is needed; steady rounds r>=20
instrument.tsc_quantum_note: this VM advances the guest TSC only in 27-tick steps at 2.699993 GHz, so 27 ticks = 10.00 ns exactly; the precedent escapeStep result of '-27 cycles' was therefore exactly ONE quantum, the instrument's minimum resolvable step
instrument.cross_check_unit: rdpmc core cycles (PERF_COUNT_HW_CPU_CYCLES, exclude_kernel, read through the perf mmap page)
instrument.rdpmc_constant_overhead_cycles: about 660-725, measured on a 6-instruction trivial player; irrelevant to P90-P50 because a constant cancels in a difference of quantiles

instrument_floor.subject: 6-instruction trivial player, interleaved rep-by-rep in the same invocation

step1_baseline_tail_width.unit: TSC ticks, code-only 38400 B eviction, min over 31 reps, 5 runs
step1_baseline_tail_width.hot_note: the entire hot-replay width is one quantum, which independently re-derives why the escapeStep precedent was invisible in ordinary hot replay

ceiling.statement: the local instrument under the precedent's own eviction condition reproduces at most about one third of the platform tail; 'P90 - P50 <= 70 ns' is not verifiable on this machine in any unit, and no platform-width claim is made anywhere in this report

step1_path_attribution.labels_from: build derived from HEAD by sim/tail_trace_patch.py; pair_diff 0/500 vs baseline on three maps; label stream re-derived twice per map with 0 mismatches; the instrumented build is never timed
step1_path_attribution.unit: TSC ticks under the 38400 B code-only eviction
findings: the slowest decile contains 0.0% no-fallback rounds on all three maps, on both counters
within-path width is 27-54 ticks (1-2 quanta) against an overall width of 81-108, so path selection rather than within-path variation dominates
path selection explains eta2 = 0.62-0.68 of round-to-round variance (0.57-0.64 on the rdpmc cross-check)

the archived hot path medians 216/243/270 are reproduced (243/243/270, span one quantum), but the span under eviction is 135-162 ticks, three times larger; hot replay prices only the work, eviction also prices the cold code the path drags in
step1_path_attribution.wave_note: 71% of wave rounds never enter the tail, because +54..81 ticks on top of a no-fallback round lands at 324-351, still below the decile cut of 378-432; only wave rounds that are also blocked cross it

step1_work_decomposition.unit: exact instruction counts (rdpmc instructions, deterministic; zero run-to-run variation) paired with TSC ticks

candidates.name: wave
candidates.knife: the %20 bomb-memory clear moves from an out-of-line cold call to an inline MASKED clear executed every round: m = -(uint32_t)(round % 20 != 0) then bombbit[i] &= m
candidates.why_masked: an UNCONDITIONAL clear, as first proposed upstream, destroys the cross-round bomb memory the rich-gate depends on and is a large behaviour change; the masked form reproduces the memset exactly when m==0 and is the identity when m==~0
candidates.d_instructions_p50: +18 on every round; +10 on wave rounds (the 8-instruction cold call is deleted)
candidates.verdict: NEGATIVE on the global P90 statistic: the -27 tick median on map1 is one quantum and is NOT supported by the rdpmc cross-check (-5 net of null), and maps 2 and 3 are flat. POSITIVE and large on the rounds it targets, at 15-20x the null floor, with zero P50 cost. Correct but not sufficient.

candidates.name: blk
candidates.knife: steerStep and escapeStep stop recomputing bpw | (rich & bombbit) per query and read the already-materialised blk[]; the two functions merge into one noinline cold function, removing the double inlining of the fallback layer into decide and the nested cold call from the tail path
candidates.proof_of_identity: pass01(r,c,rich) = ~((bpw[r+1] | (rich & bombbit[r+3])) >> (c+1)) & 1 and blk[i] = bpw[i] | (rich & bombbit[i+2]), so blk[r+1] is the same word; the reachable domain is r in [-1,17] -> blk[0..18] and blk has 19 entries
candidates.d_instructions: -9 on every round; -49 (map1) / -36 (map2) / -21 (map3) on escape rounds; instruction P90 -43 / -27 / -10
candidates.verdict: NEGATIVE. A real instruction reduction that does not convert: sign is inconsistent across maps on the fine counter and the TSC statistic does not move at all. The -49 instruction saving on escape rounds converts to about -15 core cycles, which is the null floor.

candidates.name: both
candidates.verdict: NEGATIVE. The two knives do not add; their combination is inside the null floor on both counters.

candidates.name: cst
candidates.knife: blk plus constant-shaping of the steering branch itself: blkStep is called unconditionally and its result selected with masks, so the 33-40% data-dependent branch disappears; blkStep loses its cold attribute because it is now on every round
candidates.verdict: REJECTED. P90 is WORSE on all three maps on the fine counter, and the P50 rise of +85..120 core cycles is over the +54 tick budget. It narrows the width only by lifting the floor.

candidates.name: all
candidates.decile_relocation: the slowest decile's no-fallback share rises from 0.0-2.0% to 26.7-47.2%, i.e. the 90th percentile relocated onto the raised floor rather than the tail coming down
candidates.verdict: The ONLY construct with a large, reproducible, cross-counter-consistent narrowing of P90 - P50: -66 to -76 core cycles (about -50 TSC ticks, about -18.5 ns) on all three maps against a null floor of 0 to +7. But P90 itself falls only -18 / +1 / -20 core cycles, which is under one quantum on two maps and zero on the third, and it costs +45..73 core cycles of P50. It does not meet the -2 quantum P90 bar and is NOT recommended for landing.

zero_signal_control.construct: null.so, rebuilt from a byte-for-byte copy of the baseline source into a separate file, carried through the whole pipeline: build, .text extraction, alignment check, pair_diff, and every A/B invocation interleaved rep-by-rep with the candidates
zero_signal_control.tsc_per_round_d: exactly 0 on every path subset on every map
zero_signal_control.instruction_d: 0 on every round on every map
zero_signal_control.conclusion: the control reports no change, and it reproduces the baseline's run-to-run fluctuation run for run, which is what licenses paired within-run differencing; the rdpmc dP90 floor of -4 to +4 with a per-run range up to +/-33 is the threshold every candidate figure in this report is judged against

why_the_objective_is_unreachable_by_this.band_arithmetic: P50 sits on the no-fallback band and P90 on the blocked band; the entire blocked-band excess is +81 ticks (3 quanta), so route (a), cheapening the blocked band, has a hard ceiling of 3 quanta and the target needed 2 of them
why_the_objective_is_unreachable_by_this.what_the_blocked_excess_is_made_of: +76 instructions executing at IPC 1.0, i.e. the excess is the work itself and not a branch artefact; the provable redundancy inside it is 9 instructions on all rounds plus 40 more on escape rounds, which is about -15 core cycles, at the null floor
why_the_objective_is_unreachable_by_this.why_constant_shaping_cannot_substitute: flattening moves the 90th percentile onto the raised floor instead of bringing the tail down; measured, the decile's no-fallback share goes from 0-2% to 27-47% and P90 does not fall
why_the_objective_is_unreachable_by_this.the_one_pure_footprint_source: waveTick, at 8 instructions and +54..81 ticks, is the only cost in the function that is mispredict-and-cold-call rather than work; removing it is worth about one eighth of the tail because 71% of wave rounds are not in the tail
why_the_objective_is_unreachable_by_this.residual_hypotheses_not_reachable_locall: 60-70 ns of the platform's 100 ns width is not reproduced by any local cache condition tested, so it cannot be attributed or attacked from this machine

platform_verification.statement: a tail change cannot be confirmed on the board tonight. The cumulative cost statistic pools on the order of 443,000 samples from 886 games, so a single publish moves it by about 0.06% of its weight. Confirmation needs several hundred further games. Nobody should re-read the board in an hour and conclude a knife failed.
